title: Gradient Routing Localizes and Removes Unintended Behaviors in RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.17062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a mitigation to reward hacking in reinforcement learning. Our setup involves a misspecified reward function that gives rise to unintended behavior, and a monitor used to detect unintended behavior. As with frontier AI systems, the monitor makes systematic errors. Consequently, using the monitor for data filtering or to apply a reward penalty fails to prevent the model from learning unintended behavior ("reward hacking"). To address this problem, we introduce GRAFT: Gradient Routing Adapter Fine Tuning. Rather than penalizing or filtering flagged samples during training, GRAFT constrains gradient updates on those samples to a sacrificial set of new parameters. This has two benefits: First, because the monitor is not part of the reward function, the model does not learn to hide misbehavior. translated_title: 梯度路由定位并移除强化学习中的非预期行为
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种缓解强化学习中奖励作弊（reward hacking）的方法。我们的设置包括一个因错误设定而产生非预期行为的奖励函数，以及一个用于检测非预期行为的监视器。与前沿AI系统一样，监视器会犯系统性错误。因此，使用监视器进行数据过滤或施加奖励惩罚，无法阻止模型学习到非预期行为（即“奖励作弊”）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GRAFT：梯度路由适配器微调。GRAFT不是在训练过程中对被标记的样本进行惩罚或过滤，而是将这些样本上的梯度更新约束到一组牺牲性的新参数上。这带来两个好处：第一，由于监视器不是奖励函数的一部分，模型不会学会隐藏不良行为；第二，消融这些牺牲性参数可以减少或完全消除非预期行为，同时保持目标任务上性能的提升。
tldr: 该论文提出GRAFT方法，通过将监视器标记样本的梯度更新限制到牺牲性新参数上来缓解强化学习中的奖励作弊，使模型不学会隐藏不良行为，且消融这些参数即可移除非预期行为并保持性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GRAFT, which mitigates reward hacking in RL by constraining gradient updates on monitor-flagged samples to sacrificial parameters, preventing the model from hiding misbehavior and enabling unintended behaviors to be removed via ablation while maintaining performance.
